conclusion.rationale: The patch tightens parseInteger() input contract by rejecting negative values that were previously silently wrapped by strtoul. Error message and detection point changed. This is an intentional security fix (preventing silent disable of --max-ampl on 32-bit), but it changes observable CLI behavior. CTest regression suite passes. Patch line coverage is 100%.
